title: Thank you to AiGameDev - UI improvements
author: KingofKingsofKingsof
selftext:
Yesterday I posted a demo asking for feedback.  Thank you to those who gave their constructive criticism. The video largely explains it, but in short I went from a completely made up UI where I wanted the dungeon cards to be in the background of the painting, and the players cards in the foreground, but it didn't work too well, and the visuals were too busy and saturated.  I wanted to keep the effect of the game being played in a framed painting so I did the following:

1) Desaturated the background elements - this helped.

2) Asked Claud to write a script to apply a painter's effect to the backgrounds to remove the excessive detail and noise - Kuwahara effect I believe.  Before doing this it also upscaled the backgrounds.

3) I took screenshots and asked GPT to research card game best practices.  It gave some feedback but when I explained this is the game Scoundrel, it changed it's feedback (context matters!) and suggested some layout ideas.  It also suggested adding additional help boxes on the effects of the cards.

4) I gave feedback to Claude and asked it to create screenshots of a few layout ideas, including one of my own.  I chose one of these.  But, I asked it to zoom in the playfield, so the picture frame effects happen during the level transition as the camera zooms out, and then zooms in for the actual gameplay.

  
I'm quite happy with the result.

  
Game is in threejs, build entirely in Claude, with art from ChatGPT.  Music is composed by me, but performed by Ace Studio as 'medieval covers'.

comments.author: Fit_Eye_3564
comments.body: I do miss the storybook like border, the new one is just so thin and sort of feels like its being cropped out of the view by accident. But solid game from the looks of it, hope to see it grow

replies.author: KingofKingsofKingsof
replies.body: Thanks. The border is still there, but it appears more during the level transitions. The increased game area has benefits as it now plays nicely on phones and there is more room for other things, including a new satchel feature for storing items.
